description:
We are actively seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the nursing team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This critical leadership role offers a competitive salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 per year, reflecting the importance of the position and the expertise required. We are looking to fill this role urgently with a professional who is passionate about delivering exceptional patient care and fostering a supportive environment.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be instrumental in overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of clinical care, and maintaining regulatory compliance. This is an excellent opportunity for a proven nursing leader to make a significant impact on the lives of residents and the professional development of the nursing staff.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in a nursing leadership role, preferably as a Director of Nursing or Assistant Director of Nursing
Experience within a Skilled Nursing Facility or Long-Term Care setting
Strong knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations and compliance standards
Demonstrated leadership, communication, and organizational skills

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Olathe, KS. This pivotal leadership role offers the opportunity to significantly impact patient care and support the Director of Nursing in overseeing daily clinical operations. If you are a compassionate leader with a commitment to excellence, we encourage you to apply.

As an ADON, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the highest standards of care, managing nursing staff, and maintaining regulatory compliance. This position is ideal for an RN who is ready to take on a challenging yet rewarding leadership opportunity within a supportive environment. We offer a competitive salary range of $75,000 - $85,000 per year for this vital role.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Kansas or eligibility to obtain
Prior experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Demonstrated leadership experience in a nursing capacity
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
